{{- /* The comparison key of a heading's text, so a Markdown source heading and its rendered title (.Fragments) can be matched (page-markdown.html). Expects dict "text" (the heading text) and "html" (true when it is a rendered title: inline HTML such as , entities). Returns the text in plain, lowercase ASCII: links reduced to their text, inline code ticks and emphasis markers dropped (underscores and asterisks inside words stay, as in `use_foo`), and the typographer's quotes, dashes and ellipsis written the way an author types them. */ -}} {{- $s := .text -}} {{- if .html -}} {{- $s = htmlUnescape (plainify $s) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $s = replaceRE `\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)` "$1" $s -}} {{- $s = replace $s "`" "" -}} {{- $s = replaceRE `(^|[\s(])[*_]+` "$1" $s -}} {{- $s = replaceRE `[*_]+([\s).,:;!?]|$)` "$1" $s -}} {{- end -}} {{- $typographic := dict "’" "'" "‘" "'" "“" "\"" "”" "\"" "«" "<<" "»" ">>" "–" "--" "—" "---" "…" "..." -}} {{- range $from, $to := $typographic }}{{ $s = replace $s $from $to }}{{ end -}} {{- return lower (strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " $s)) -}}
